paper.quote: When dismantle is applied on a loop, this loop and all its outer loops are unrolled and specialized with the given sparsity attribute.
we introduce a new schedule primitive dismantle that jointly performs loop unrolling and DCE.

analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The shown code only maps dismantle values to pre-existing kernel templates (dense, finegrained, blocksparse). It does not implement loop unrolling, specialization expansion, or DCE; it selects and returns generated kernel code. This matches the finding that the artifact path consumes pre-generated kernels rather than performing dismantle expansion.
analysis.would_confirm: Inspect the full specialization pipeline to verify whether any later stage performs dismantle-driven unrolling/DCE rather than only template selection.
